[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Luxor from Latin 'lūx' (light) + '-or' (state/condition); cf. lūx, lūcis",
    "reading": "The state of being light; a place where light dwells or is generated.",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "Lewis & Short, A Latin Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.9
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Lu + xor; 'lu' (Fr. 'loup' = wolf, but also 'lu' past participle of lire) + 'xor' (sounds like 'sor' from 'sors' = fate)",
    "reading": "The wolf of fate; or that which has been read as destiny.",
    "languages": ["fr","la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Luxor ~ 'lucks or' (English 'luck' + 'or') ~ 'lucksore' (old word for a sore from lying down)",
    "reading": "Either fortune or a wound; a choice between blessing and affliction.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Luxor → 'xulor' → 'xul' (old English for 'sorrow'?) + 'or' (gold in French)",
    "reading": "Sorrow turned to gold; alchemical inversion of grief into treasure.",
    "languages": ["en","fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "L-U-X-O-R: Lumen, Umbra, Xenos, Ordo, Radius — light, shadow, stranger, order, ray",
    "reading": "A ray of light ordering the shadow of the stranger; a cosmic law of contrast.",
    "languages": ["la","grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "L (el = God in Hebrew) + U (you) + X (cross) + O (circle) + R (head/resh)",
    "reading": "God in you, the cross within the circle, crowned by the head — a hieroglyph of self-divinity.",
    "languages": ["he","en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "L=30, U=21, X=24, O=15, R=18 (A1Z26) → sum 108; 108 is sacred in Hindu/Buddhist counts",
    "reading": "The number 108 — a complete cycle of breaths or names; Luxor as a threshold of totality.",
    "languages": ["en","sa"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Luxor → 'luke' (light, from Greek leukos) + 'sor' (sister in Latin, soror)",
    "reading": "The bright sister; a feminine luminance, a twin of dawn.",
    "languages": ["grc","la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  }
]
